verdict.rationale: The open-source Whisper repo documents a choice of six model sizes, plus English-only variants and a 'turbo' model, explicitly framed as speed and accuracy tradeoffs. The API docs name a gpt-transcribe model, and community reports corroborate that larger models are more accurate but much slower. However, the pack contains no published accuracy figures, latency figures, or per-model cost comparison. missing for 10: published accuracy metrics per model, quantified latency figures, documented cost tradeoffs across models, API-side model comparison table

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose among documented transcription models with published accuracy, latency, and cost tradeoffs

citations.quote: There are six model sizes, four with English-only versions, offering speed and accuracy tradeoffs.
